digest.component_or_area: repo root from tracker path resolution
propositions: On a relocated store, sites reading compose_config() must resolve the code repo root via config.repo_root_or_none(), not dirname(realpath(tracker)), to access rebar.toml in the checkout

All git operations and attribution queries on the store's own repo that do not read compose_config() must route through the single shared seam rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker) to preserve behavior on relocated stores

The guard script check_repo_root_from_tracker.py must unwrap str()/realpath()/abspath() and dirname(StorePaths(tracker).canonical) spellings and permit only the seam marker '# repo-root-seam:' or sanctioned sites '# repo-root-ok:' to prevent divergence by construction

Config-read sites in reads.py, freshness.py, and fsck_tracker_health.py calling tickets_branch/tickets_remote must use code repo root, not store-parent root, on relocated stores—each change is behavior-altering and requires a RED→GREEN oracle test
